# ankra_playground_plans (Data Source)

The playground sizes the organisation can order, for `ankra_playground.plan`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster playground plans`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_playground_plans" "all" {}

output "available_playground_plans" {
  value = [for plan in data.ankra_playground_plans.all.plans : plan.id if plan.available]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency of the prices.
- `default_plan_id` (String) Plan a playground gets when none is ordered (the free trial).
- `organisation_has_paid_plan` (Boolean) Whether the organisation can be invoiced for a paid size.
- `organisation_has_payment_card` (Boolean) Whether the organisation has a payment card on file.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Orderable sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))
- `quota_limit_mib` (Number) The organisation's playground memory budget, in MiB.
- `quota_used_mib` (Number) Memory its playgrounds already use, in MiB.

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether a host has capacity for this size right now.
- `currency` (String) Currency of the price.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Plan id, the value of `ankra_playground.plan`.
- `max_pods` (Number) Pod limit.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory, in GB.
- `price_monthly_cents` (Number) Monthly price, in cents.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Storage, in GB.
- `summary` (String) One-line description.
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs.
